d: In this video, you will learn how to automate your exit strategy and protect your profits using the Trailing Stoploss (TSL) feature on the Kite app. Manually tracking the market and updating your stop loss takes up too much time and can lead to missed profits if the price suddenly reverses. With Trailing Stop Loss in GTT orders, your stop loss price automatically adjusts as the market moves in your favor, helping you lock in gains while keeping downside protection intact.
